## 相容性與公開資料

## 驗證

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:quality`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] 若修改 Studio：`npm run check:browser`
- [ ] 若修改部署規則：`npm run check:studio-deployment`
- [ ] 若修改 starter content：`npm run check:template-defaults`
